title: The Strength of the Few
author: James Islington
summary: The second Hierarchy novel continues the story of a young man living under an empire built on a system where citizens hand part of their strength upward. It deepens the secrets, rivalries and dangers around him.
readIf: you finished The Will of the Many and want more of its layered, secret-heavy empire.
skipIf: you have not read book one, since this one is hard to follow without it.

pairings.reason: The first Hierarchy book, where the empire and its rules are introduced.
Another story of an outsider climbing through a ruthless, hierarchical society to break it from within.
A long, immersive fantasy about a gifted young man and a school that tests him.
